### Prerequisites:
- Display screen, remote control, storage media (SD card, hard disk, etc.)

### Alarm duration description:
- Alarm pre-recording duration: the time from the moment the alarm occurs to the moment the alarm occurs, that is, the alarm recording start time
- Alarm delay duration: the time from the moment the alarm occurs to the moment the alarm occurs, that is, the recording alarm end time
- Alarm recording duration = alarm pre-recording duration + alarm delay duration. For example, if the device triggers an alarm at 12:01:00, the configured alarm pre-recording duration and alarm delay duration are 30s respectively. The alarm recording start time is 12:00:30 and the end time is 12:01:30, and the recording duration is 1 minute
- This configuration applies to all types of alarm recording durations of the device, such as AI, IO....

###Operation steps

1. Press the [ENTER] button on the remote control to enter the login interface, enter the password "999999", and automatically log in to the main menu
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=9b564035b2a5a51685d9852bcb3edd6c)

2. Select [Settings] on the main menu interface and press the "ENTER" button to enter the settings interface
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=b0de39de2ad5030607dff091a8f87989)

3. Select [Settings] in the [Alarm] interface and press the "ENTER" key to enter
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=97b0d3ca150395612fea25206da22d8e)

4. Press the "ENTER" key on the default first page [Alarm ] to enter the editing state. If it is not on the first page [Alarm ], press the left and right arrow keys to move to this page, press the remote control down key to move to the "Alarm Pre-recording Duration" and "Alarm Delayed Recording Duration" input boxes to fill in the duration, confirm and save, and restart to trigger the alarm to take effect.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=22913245adb10137325a70165c074a40)
